workload: pi0, 3 views, prompt 0, 50 actions, 10 denoising steps, B200

native.phase_method: Hazy VM per-worker timing spans (median cycles: 25221185.5, 42392767.5, 289119522.5), scaled to the uninstrumented full-model GPU median; approximate because profiling changes execution

realtime_vla.phase_method: CUDA event nodes inside a captured graph, seven replays; total includes input copies and graph overhead

comparison.caveat: Realtime-VLA uses independent random weights and its BF16 implementation; numerical equivalence to the native OpenPI-weight model was not established. Phase attribution in the native kernel is approximate.
